name: Applin
description: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.description: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.description: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Pounce
moves.description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.description: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
